about: Statement/proof split registry, checked by scripts/check_claim_statements.py. Field names follow formalization.yaml v0.4 (main_results scope, literature_dependencies, fidelity.divergences, review.status, automation.methods); ideas only, nothing from openai/math@1581d4cb is cited as proved.

results.meaning: A similarity z |-> (a + b i) z + t or (a + b i) conj(z) + t, with a + b i <> 0 (sim_k2 = a^2 + b^2 <> 0), maps the CircularArc through three controls to the arc through their images: squared distance scales by a^2 + b^2, validity, centre and radius are transported, and on_arc membership is preserved both ways.
Every rational affine map accepted by is_similarity_q (decided by is_similarity_q_dec) is exact on arcs when applied to the three control points.

One sample, not a converse: the non-similarity scale (2,1) moves the controls of the unit upper arc so that the image (6/5,4/5) of the arc point (3/5,4/5) is off the image arc; the Q twin computes the squared residual 12/25 at that single point (3/5,4/5). It is not the maximum: over the arc the residual is 3y(1-y), maximum 3/4 at (sqrt 3/2, 1/2) (ArcSimilarityImage.v : scale21_resid_max).

fidelity_divergences: R, not binary64: JTS/NTS/GEOS transform doubles; rounding of the moved controls is not modelled.
3-point SQL/MM arc (CurveGeometry.CircularArc), not a centre/radius arc; ExactCircularArc is the JTS Java class and is not modelled here.

Suspected, not verified: GEOS GEOSGeom_transformXY (curve support since 3.13) moves arc control points independently, so for a non-similarity callback the output is the circle through the moved controls, not the image of the arc. The witness shows one such map; the GEOS behaviour itself is being reproduced separately.
The converse (an affine map exact on every arc is a similarity) is not claimed.

results.meaning: A placed clothoid o + M c (host Fresnel egg c, any 2x2 M) under an affine map f(p) = b + L p is the placed clothoid (f(o), L M) over the same egg; the action is a left action (identity, composition), multiplies det M by det L, and commutes with split, reverse and the chord demote.

Every affine map with det L <> 0 has a two-sided inverse in the group; the image's arc-length point is f of the point and its tangent is L of the tangent; that tangent is the derivative of the placed arc; tangent cross products scale by det L, so parallel (touching) tangents stay parallel.
One sample: the GEOS #1566 shear (u, v) = ((2, 0), (1/2, 1)), det 2, columns of unequal length, is the image of the identity placement of geos_shear_egg under one linear map.

fidelity_divergences: R, not binary64: the moved origin and the product L M are exact; GEOS / NTS compute them in doubles.
Placement is planar (no Z / M), as in ClothoidPlacement.v.
Representation level only: curvature and arc length of the image are claim cloth-linear-law-iff-similarity; equivariance of intersection / noding (ADR-0007 sheet transport) is not claimed here.
Not claimed: absorbing a similarity lam R into the host egg (lam c_A(t) = c_{lam A}(lam t)), so a similarity placement is not yet shown to be a host MkClothoid.

results.meaning: For a non-degenerate host clothoid (A, h2, d <> 0) and det M <> 0, on any window s1 < s2 the placed curvature signed_curv (M v) (M a) is a + b * sg for some sg with sg' = |M v| (curvature linear in placed arc length) if and only if M^T M = lam^2 I (M is a similarity, rotation or reflection).
Pointwise rigidity: at one unit vector v, M v . M J v = 0 and |M J v| = |M v| already force M^T M = lam^2 I; the converse ends on this step.

The GEOS #1566 sheared placement (u, v) = ((2, 0), (1/2, 1)) over geos_shear_egg has no window, however short, with curvature linear in placed arc length (geos_shear_curvature_not_affine was the window (0, 11) in host arc length only).

fidelity_divergences: Linearity in placed arc length is stated through any antiderivative sg of the placed speed on the open window, not through a placed-length integral (placed length itself stays parked in ClothoidPlacement.v).
Proof route: one derivative of the law and one of its consequence, elimination to a quartic in Q = |M v|^2 with nonzero constant term 4 g D^3, IVT and a five-root count; no analytic continuation.

backs: sheared clothoids need their own curve class (shear plan, statement B)
